# January metadata

```{r}
jan_metadata_everythingmod <- jan_metadata %>% 
  rename(
    SAMPLE = X
  ) %>% 
    mutate_all(as.character) %>%
  select(SAMPLE, sample_type, location_name, depth_category, filter, lat, long, pH, site, year, temp, prok, eukCONC) %>% 
  filter(filter != "postPCR") %>% 
  filter(filter != "NA") %>% 
  filter(location_name != "Soupy background")
```



```{r}
jan_metadata_everythingformatted <- jan_metadata_everythingmod %>% 
  mutate(DATASET = case_when(
    grepl("_GR_", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("Gorda", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("_MCR_", SAMPLE) ~ "MCR",
    grepl("Axial", SAMPLE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial")) %>% 
  filter(year != 2013) %>% 
  filter(year != 2014) %>% 
  filter(year != 2015) %>% 
  filter(year != 2019) %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "under plume") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "plume top") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "30m above") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "above vent") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "euphotic") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "oxycline") %>% 
  filter(sample_type != "incubation") %>% 
  filter(sample_type != "control") %>% 
  filter (filter != "GFF") %>% 
  filter(SAMPLE != "62_TAACAC_S14")
```

```{r}

regions   <- c("MCR","AXIAL")
locations <- c("BSW","Plume","ArrowLoop","WhiteCastle","MustardStand","ShrimpHole",
               "Shrimpocalypse","Rav2","LotsOShrimp","Anemone","BagCity","Gollum",
               "Diva","Mkr33","Mkr113","Background","Vixen","ASHES","IntlDist","OldManTree")

jan_metadata_everythingformatted <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>%
  mutate(
    pH = as.numeric(pH),
    temp = as.numeric(temp),
    prok = as.numeric(prok),
    eukCONC = as.numeric(eukCONC)) %>% 
    mutate(
    VentField = case_when(
      grepl("Axial", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial_Seamount",
      grepl("Piccard", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      grepl("VonDamm", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      TRUE ~ site 
    )
  )

up_janmetadata <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>% 
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>%
  group_by(merged_sampleid) %>%
  summarise(
    pH = na_if(mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    temp = na_if(mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    prok = na_if(mean(prok, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    eukCONC = na_if(mean(eukCONC, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(merged_sampleid)
```

## Renaming dataset

```{r}
df_fixed <- deepsea_18S_asv_FinalProduct %>%
rename(FeatureID = `Feature.ID`) %>%  # changed the name so the asv table and metadata table match
 rename(value = `SEQUENCE_COUNT`) %>%

```


## Filtering out prokaryotes

```{r}
new_MCR <- df_fixed %>%  # filtering out prokaryotes
  filter(DATASET == "MCR") %>% 
  filter(Supergroup != "Terrabacteria") %>% 
  filter(Supergroup != "Archaea_X") %>% 
  filter(Supergroup != "Bacteria_X") %>% 
  filter(Supergroup != "CMS") %>% 
  filter(Supergroup != "FCB") %>% 
  filter(Phylum != "Aquificae") %>% 
  filter(Phylum != "Euryarchaeota") %>% #has methanogens, acidophiles and thermophiles
  filter(Phylum != "Proteobacteria") %>% 
  filter(Type != "expTf") %>% 
  filter(Class != "Metazoa") %>% 
  filter(value >= 10)
# removed incubation data, i am only interested in shipboard and insitu samples
  #mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species))
```

```{r}

  select(FeatureID, Taxon, Domain, Supergroup, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, new_class, supergroup_final) %>%

  select(FeatureID, SAMPLE, value, SAMPLETYPE, SITE, COORDINATES, DEPTH, TEMP, pH, Perc, Mg, H2, H2S, CH4, LOCATION, DEPTH_CATEGORY, PRIMER, FLUID_COLLECTION, AXIAL.YEAR, EXPERIMENT, DOC..um., POC..um., TDN.um., Prok_min, Prok_mid, Prok_mid2, Prok_max, ProkConc ) %>%
```

# Vent Field Column
```{r}
test_combined_axmcr <- axm %>% #axmcr_combined
   mutate(
    VentField = case_when(
      grepl("AXIAL", SAMPLE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial_Seamount",
      grepl("Piccard", SITE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      grepl("VonDamm", SITE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      TRUE ~ SITE 
    )
  ) %>% 
   mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species)) %>% 
  filter(LOCATION != "Soupy background") %>% 
  filter(SAMPLE != "AXIAL_23_138_J21501_Mkr113_UFO_vent_shipboard_sterivex_SHIPBOARD_18S") %>% 
  filter(SAMPLE != "AXIAL_23_154_J21505_Mkr113_SUPR_vent_F1206_PES02_INSITU_18S") %>%
  filter(SAMPLE != "AXIAL_23_164_J21502_Mkr33_UFO_vent_F8_sterivex_INSITU_18S") %>% 
  filter(filter != "GFF")

endemic_taxa <- endem %>% 
  mutate(
    VentField = case_when(
      grepl("AXIAL", SAMPLE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial_Seamount",
       grepl("Piccard", SITE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      grepl("VonDamm", SITE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      TRUE ~ SITE
    )
  )
```


```{r}
unique(test_combined_axmcr$sample_abbrev)

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Known regions and locations


regions   <- c("MCR","AXIAL")
locations <- c("BSW","Plume","ArrowLoop","WhiteCastle","MustardStand","ShrimpHole",
               "Shrimpocalypse","Rav2","LotsOShrimp","Anemone","BagCity","Gollum",
               "Diva","Mkr33","Mkr113","Background","Vixen","ASHES","IntlDist","OldManTree")

new_mergedids <- test_combined_axmcr %>% 
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    total_sequences = as.numeric(value),
    # Create a merged sample ID independent of the original SAMPLE
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>%
  # Group by the real sample (not the original SAMPLE) + FeatureID
  group_by(merged_sampleid, FeatureID, SAMPLE) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


new_mergedids_up <- new_mergedids %>% 
  select(SAMPLE, FeatureID, total_sequences, merged_sampleid)

filler_data <- test_combined_axmcr %>% 
  select(SAMPLE, FeatureID, Domain, Supergroup, supergroup_final, Phylum, Class, new_class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, LOCATION, SITE, SAMPLETYPE, DEPTH,DEPTH_CATEGORY, FLUID_COLLECTION, vent_endemic, filter, VentField, Species_Annotation)


new_merged <-  left_join(filler_data, new_mergedids_up, by = c("SAMPLE", "FeatureID"))

length(unique(new_merged$FeatureID))

unique(new_merged$merged_sampleid)
```

# Start of donut plots

```{r}
background <- new_merged %>% 
  filter(SAMPLETYPE == "background")

donutback <- background %>% 
    group_by(Phylum, new_class, SITE, FeatureID) %>% 
  summarise(total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
            total_sequences = sum(total_sequences)) 

donutback <- donutback %>%
  group_by(SITE) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction = total_sequences / sum(total_sequences),
    #percent = paste0(round(100 * fraction, 1), "%"),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
mutate(unknown_end_asvs = case_when(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & vent > 0 ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)) %>% mutate(count_end_seqs = case_when(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" ~ vent, TRUE ~ 0)) %>%
```

```{r}
up_axmcr_class <- test_combined_axmcr %>% 
  mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species))

class_everything <- up_axmcr_class %>%
  tidyr::unite(PHYLUM_CLASS, Phylum, Class, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    everything_total_sequences = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    amount_all_asvs_NAs = n_distinct(
      FeatureID[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & value > 0]
    ),
    amount_all_seqs_NA = sum(
      value[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


class_level_endemic <- axmcr_endem_taxa %>% unique() %>% 
  mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species)) %>% 
  distinct(FeatureID, Phylum, Class, Species_Annotation) %>%
  tidyr::unite(PHYLUM_CLASS, Phylum, Class, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS) %>%
  summarise(
    endemic_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    endemic_total_sequences = sum(vent, na.rm = TRUE),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = n_distinct(
      FeatureID[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & vent > 0]
    ),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = sum(
      vent[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

total_seqs <- sum(class_everything$everything_total_sequences)
total_asvs <- sum(class_everything$everything_total_asvs)

true_total_asvs <- up_axmcr_class %>%
  summarise(n = n_distinct(FeatureID)) %>%
  pull(n)

class_math_axmcr_end_ev <- class_axmcr_end_ev %>%
  mutate(
    percent_endemic_asvs = endemic_total_asvs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_endemic_seqs = endemic_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_end_asvs  = amount_end_asvs_NAs / endemic_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_all_asvs  = amount_all_asvs_NAs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_end_seqs  = amount_end_seqs_NA / endemic_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_all_seqs  = amount_all_seqs_NA / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_all_asvs_of_total = everything_total_asvs / true_total_asvs,
    percent_all_seqs_of_total = everything_total_sequences / total_seqs
  )
view(class_math_axmcr_end_ev)
stopifnot(
  all(class_math_axmcr_end_ev$percent_NA_all_asvs <= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(class_math_axmcr_end_ev$percent_NA_end_asvs <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)

write_csv(class_math_axmcr_end_ev, file = "~/Documents/GitHub/AXMCR/class_math_axmcr_end_ev.csv")
```

```{r}
# Setting up rank abundance curve
rac  <- axmcr_actual %>% 
  group_by(new_class, Phylum, Species, status, FeatureID) %>% 
  summarise(Abundance = sum(total_sequences)) %>% 
  group_by(FeatureID) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(desc(Abundance)) %>% 
  mutate(Rank = row_number()) 
  #mutate(vent_endemic = if_else(is.na(vent_endemic), "not_endemic", vent_endemic))

 racplot<- ggplot(rac,aes(x = Rank, y = Abundance, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") + scale_fill_manual(values = rac_colors) +
  labs(x = "Rank", y = "Abundance", fill = "status", title = "Rank Abundance Curve") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
                                            axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16), 
                                            plot.title = element_text(size = 18))
  ggsave("big.svg", width = 20, height = 10, device = "svg", limitsize = FALSE)
```

# Finding vent only asvs

```{r}
test_vent_asvs <- new_merged %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(SAMPLETYPE) == 1, SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>%
  ungroup()

test_vent_asvs_info <- new_merged %>%
  filter(SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>% 
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


asvs_info <- new_merged %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    in_vent= any(SAMPLETYPE == "vent"),
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_vent) %>%  # keep only ASVs present in Lake
  ungroup()

test_asvsInfor <- asvs_info %>% 
  filter(also_in_other_st == FALSE)

length(unique(test_asvsInfor$FeatureID))

ventonly_asv <- new_merged %>% left_join(test_asvsInfor) %>% 
  drop_na(in_vent)

length(unique(ventonly_asv$FeatureID))

#asvs_vent <- asvs_info %>%

 #   status = case_when(

   #   in_vent &  also_in_other_st ~ "nonvent",
   #   TRUE                           ~ "nonvent"
   # )
 # )

asvs_vent <- asvs_info %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      is.na(in_vent) == TRUE ~ "vent",
      in_vent == TRUE & also_in_other_st == FALSE ~ "resident",
      in_vent == TRUE & also_in_other_st == TRUE ~ "cosmopolitan",
      in_vent == FALSE ~ "cosmopolitan"
    )
  )

length(unique(asvs_vent$FeatureID))

axmcr_actual <- new_merged %>% left_join(asvs_vent) %>% 
  mutate(status = case_when(SAMPLETYPE %in% c("plume", "background") ~ "cosmopolitan",
      TRUE ~ status))
```

```{r}
matrix_heatstrip <- new_merged %>% 
  select(FeatureID, merged_sampleid, total_sequences) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = merged_sampleid, values_from = total_sequences, values_fn = mean, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "FeatureID") %>% as.matrix()

pca_clr <- prcomp(data.frame(compositions::clr(t(matrix_heatstrip))))

variance_clr <- (pca_clr$sdev^2)/sum(pca_clr$sdev^2)

barplot(variance_clr, main = "Log-Ratio PCA Screeplot", xlab = "PC Axis", ylab = "% Variance", 
        cex.names = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.5, cex.main = 1.5)
```

```{r}
PCA_PLOT <- data.frame(pca_clr$x, SAMPLE = rownames(pca_clr$x)) %>% 
  select(PC1, PC2, SAMPLE) %>% 
  left_join(heatstrip_info, by = "SAMPLE") %>% 
  # Factoring
  mutate(
    pH_order = factor(pH_range, levels = unique(pH_range))
  )%>% 
  #mutate(FEATURE = str_replace_na(FEATURE, replacement = "other")) %>% 
  ## Generate PCA plot
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, 
             fill = pH_order)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#525252") +
  geom_jitter(stroke = 0.6, size = 2.5, width = 0.8) +
  ylab(paste0('PC2 ',round(variance_clr[2]*100,2),'%')) +
  xlab(paste0('PC1 ',round(variance_clr[1]*100,2),'%')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(24, 23, 21, 22)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ph_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color="black", size=12),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed"),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black", size= 12),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8, face = "bold"),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 1, 2, 1, "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
    color = "black",
```

```{r}
  theme_dendro() + labs(y = "Dissimilarity") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
          axis.line.x = element_line(color = "#252525"), 
        axis.ticks.x = element_line(), axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black",
```

```{r}
#install.packages("ggdendro")
#library(ggdendro)

# distance between samples
heatstrip_dist <- dist(t(matrix_heatstrip), method = "euclidean")

# cluster
heatstrip_cluster <- hclust(heatstrip_dist, method = "complete")

# set as dendrogram object
dend <- as.dendrogram(heatstrip_cluster)


labels_pH <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_temp <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_counts <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_euks <- as.character(labels(dend))

sample_order <- c("AXIAL_Background", "AXIAL_BSW", "AXIAL_ASHES", "AXIAL_Anemone", "AXIAL_BagCity", "AXIAL_Diva", "AXIAL_Gollum", "AXIAL_IntlDist", "AXIAL_Mkr113", "AXIAL_Mkr33", "AXIAL_Vixen", "MCR_BSW", "MCR_ArrowLoop",  "MCR_LotsOShrimp", "MCR_MustardStand", "MCR_OldManTree", "MCR_Plume", "MCR_Rav2", "MCR_ShrimpHole", "MCR_Shrimpocalypse", "MCR_WhiteCastle")  

label_order = factor(sample_order, levels = sample_order)
label_order = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = merged_sampleid)

anno_pH <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(pH, pH_range, merged_sampleid, temp, temp_range, VentField) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_pH) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  # alphabetical order (left → right)
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%
  mutate(label_order = factor(sample_order, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  mutate(pH_range = factor(pH_range, levels = pH_levels))

anno_temp <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(pH, pH_range, merged_sampleid, temp, temp_range, VentField) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_temp) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%   # alphabetical
  mutate(label_order = factor(sample_order, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  mutate(temp_range = factor(temp_range, levels = temp_levels))

anno_counts <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(pH, pH_range, merged_sampleid, temp, temp_range, VentField, log_prok_range, log_prok) %>%
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_counts) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%  # alphabetical order
  mutate(label_order = factor(sample_order, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  mutate(log_prok_range = factor(log_prok_range, levels = proklog_levels))


anno_euks <- heatstrip_info %>% 
select(eukCONC, EukConc_range, merged_sampleid, VentField, log_euk, log_euk_range) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_euks) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%  # alphabetical order
  mutate(label_order = factor(sample_order, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
 #mutate(EukConc_range = factor(EukConc_range, levels = euk_levels))
  mutate(log_euk_range = factor(log_euk_range, levels = euklog_levels))
```

# Donut plot for Vent exclusive

```{r}
donutventex <- axmcr_actual %>% 
  select(FeatureID, new_class, total_sequences, status, VentField) %>% 
  filter(status == "resident")

ventex <- donutventex %>% 
    group_by(new_class, VentField) %>% 
  summarise(total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
            total_sequences = sum(total_sequences))

ventex <- ventex %>%
  group_by(VentField) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction = total_sequences / sum(total_sequences),
    #percent = paste0(round(100 * fraction, 1), "%"),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


ventexplot <- ggplot(ventex, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3, fill= new_class)) + 
geom_rect() + scale_fill_manual(values = classes_and_colors) + facet_wrap(~VentField, scales = "free") +
     coord_polar(theta="y") + # Try to remove that to understand how the chart is built initially
     xlim(c(2, 4)) + theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Resident Vent Taxa")
#ggsave("venthosted.svg", width = 20, height = 10, device = "svg", limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r}
metadata_everythingformatted <- metadata_everythingformatted %>% 
  mutate(DATASET = case_when(
    grepl("_GR_", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("Gorda", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("_MCR_", SAMPLE) ~ "MCR",
    grepl("Axial", SAMPLE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial")) %>% 
  filter(year != 2013) %>% 
  filter(year != 2014) %>% 
  filter(year != 2015) %>% 
  filter(year != 2019) %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "under plume") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "peak plume") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "plume top") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "30m above") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "above vent") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "euphotic") %>% 
  filter(depth_category != "oxycline") %>% 
  filter(sample_type != "incubation") %>% 
  filter(sample_type != "control") %>% 
  filter (filter != "GFF")
```

# All New Phyloseq object

```{r}
new_merged_taxon <- new_merged %>% 
  select(FeatureID, Domain, Supergroup, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species) %>% distinct() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "FeatureID") %>% 
  as.matrix()

new_merged_asvs <- new_merged %>% 
  dplyr::select(FeatureID, merged_sampleid, total_sequences) %>% distinct()

new_merged_asvs_matrix <- new_merged_asvs %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = merged_sampleid,
    values_from = total_sequences,
    values_fill = 0,
    values_fn = sum # for duplicates
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "FeatureID") %>%
  as.matrix()

new_merged_taxa = tax_table(new_merged_taxon)
new_merged_otu_asvs = otu_table(new_merged_asvs_matrix, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

class(new_merged_otu_asvs)
str(new_merged_otu_asvs)

head(new_merged_asvs_matrix)
str(new_merged_otu_asvs)


metadata_clean <- metadata_january %>%
  filter(!is.na(merged_sampleid))


new_merged_physeq_object <- merge_phyloseq(new_merged_otu_asvs, new_merged_taxa, metadata_clean)



```

```{r}
# Calculate Shannon diversity directly from your OTU table
shannon_div <- estimate_richness(otu_table(new_merged_asvs_matrix, taxa_are_rows = TRUE), measures = "Shannon")

# Make a quick dataframe
shannon_div$Sample <- rownames(shannon_div)

# If you have metadata, merge what you can
# Replace NAs in SampleType or VentField with "Unknown"
metadata_quick <- metadata_january %>%
  filter(!is.na(merged_sampleid)) %>%
  distinct(merged_sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = ifelse(is.na(sample_type), "Unknown", sample_type),
    VentField = ifelse(is.na(VentField), "Unknown", VentField)
  )
rownames(metadata_quick) <- metadata_quick$merged_sampleid

shannon_div <- merge(shannon_div, metadata_quick, by.x = "Sample", by.y = "merged_sampleid", all.x = TRUE)

# Quick scatter plot
ggplot(shannon_div, aes(x = sample_type, y = Shannon, color =location_name)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Shannon Diversity",
    x = "Sample Type",
    y = "Shannon Diversity",
    color = "Vent Field"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = div_colors)
  #scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma")

```


```{r}
otu_wide <- new_merged %>%
  select(merged_sampleid, FeatureID, total_sequences) %>%
  group_by(merged_sampleid, FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(total_sequences = sum(total_sequences), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = FeatureID,
    values_from = total_sequences,
    values_fill = 0
  )

sample_ids <- otu_wide$merged_sampleid
comm_matrix <- otu_wide %>% select(-merged_sampleid) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(comm_matrix) <- sample_ids

shannon <- diversity(comm_matrix, index = "shannon")
simpson <- 1 - diversity(comm_matrix, index = "simpson")
chao1 <- estimateR(comm_matrix)["S.chao1", ]

div_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = sample_ids,
  Shannon = shannon,
  Simpson = simpson,
  Chao1 = chao1
)


metadata_quick <- metadata_january %>%
  filter(!is.na(merged_sampleid)) %>%
  distinct(merged_sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type    = ifelse(is.na(sample_type), "Unknown", sample_type),
    location_name  = ifelse(is.na(location_name), "Unknown", location_name),
    VentField      = ifelse(is.na(VentField), "Unknown", VentField)
  )

div_table <- div_table %>%
  left_join(metadata_quick, by = c("Sample" = "merged_sampleid"))


loc_colors <- viridis::viridis(n = length(unique(div_table$location_name)), option = "plasma")
names(loc_colors) <- unique(div_table$location_name)


plot_diversity <- function(df, index_name) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = sample_type, y = !!sym(index_name), color = location_name)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.25, size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(~VentField) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste(index_name, "by Sample Type"),
      x = "Sample Type",
      y = index_name,
      color = "Location"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = div_colors) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
    )
}


shannon_plot <- plot_diversity(div_table, "Shannon")
simpson_plot <- plot_diversity(div_table, "Simpson")
chao1_plot   <- plot_diversity(div_table, "Chao1")

# Display them
shannon_plot
simpson_plot
chao1_plot

```

```{r}
  scale_fill_viridis_c() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1.0, size = 14), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14)) + theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
    #panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray"),
    #panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray")
  ) + labs(title = "Correlation Plot for Vent Exclusive Samples") +
scale_fill_stepsn(colors = blorange, breaks = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1))
ggsave("vent_dotplot.svg", width = 20, height = 10, device = "svg", limitsize = FALSE)
```

```{r}
class_everything <- new_merged %>%
  mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species)) %>%
  unite(PHYLUM_CLASS, Phylum, new_class, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS, FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
            Species_Annotation = first(Species_Annotation),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    everything_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    amount_all_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_all_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

class_level_endemic <- ventonly_asv %>%
  mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species)) %>%
  unite(PHYLUM_CLASS, Phylum, new_class, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS, FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
            Species_Annotation = first(Species_Annotation),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS) %>%
  summarise(
    endemic_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    endemic_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

class_axmcr_end_ev <- class_everything %>%
  left_join(class_level_endemic, by = "PHYLUM_CLASS") %>%
  mutate(
    endemic_total_asvs = ifelse(is.na(endemic_total_asvs), 0, endemic_total_asvs),
    endemic_total_sequences = ifelse(is.na(endemic_total_sequences), 0, endemic_total_sequences),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = ifelse(is.na(amount_end_asvs_NAs), 0, amount_end_asvs_NAs),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = ifelse(is.na(amount_end_seqs_NA), 0, amount_end_seqs_NA)
  )

total_seqs <- sum(class_axmcr_end_ev$everything_total_sequences)
total_asvs <- sum(class_axmcr_end_ev$everything_total_asvs)

class_math_axmcr_end_ev <- class_axmcr_end_ev %>%
  mutate(
    percent_endemic_asvs = endemic_total_asvs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_endemic_seqs = endemic_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_end_asvs = ifelse(endemic_total_asvs == 0, 0, amount_end_asvs_NAs / endemic_total_asvs),
    percent_NA_all_asvs = amount_all_asvs_NAs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_end_seqs = ifelse(endemic_total_sequences == 0, 0, amount_end_seqs_NA / endemic_total_sequences),
    percent_NA_all_seqs = amount_all_seqs_NA / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_all_asvs_of_total = everything_total_asvs / total_asvs,
    percent_all_seqs_of_total = everything_total_sequences / total_seqs
  )

class_end_ev_combined_table <- class_math_axmcr_end_ev %>% 
  dplyr::select(PHYLUM_CLASS,everything_total_asvs, endemic_total_asvs, everything_total_sequences, endemic_total_sequences, amount_all_asvs_NAs, amount_end_asvs_NAs, amount_all_seqs_NA, amount_end_seqs_NA, percent_endemic_asvs, percent_endemic_seqs, percent_NA_end_asvs, percent_NA_all_asvs, percent_NA_end_seqs, percent_NA_all_seqs,percent_all_asvs_of_total, percent_all_seqs_of_total)

# --- Step 5: Safety check ---
stopifnot(all(class_math_axmcr_end_ev$percent_endemic_seqs <= 1))

# --- Step 6: View and save ---
view(class_math_axmcr_end_ev)
write_csv(class_end_ev_combined_table, "~/Documents/GitHub/AXMCR/class_math_axmcr_end_ev.csv")
```

```{r}
new_merged_taxon <- new_merged %>% 
  select(FeatureID, Domain, Supergroup, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species) %>% distinct() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "FeatureID") %>% 
  as.matrix()

new_merged_asvs <- new_merged %>% 
  dplyr::select(FeatureID, merged_sampleid, total_sequences) %>% distinct()

new_merged_asvs_matrix <- new_merged_asvs %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = merged_sampleid,
    values_from = total_sequences,
    values_fill = 0,
    values_fn = sum # for duplicates
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "FeatureID") %>%
  as.matrix()

rda_response <- t(new_merged_asvs_matrix)
```

```{r}
env_matrix <- metadata_quick %>% 
   column_to_rownames(var = "merged_sampleid")

env_matrix <- env_matrix %>% select(pH, temp)
all(rownames(rda_response) %in% rownames(env_matrix))

# samples present in both
# Keep only rows with no NA in env variables
# Remove rows with any NA
env_matrix_clean <- na.omit(env_matrix)

# Subset response matrix to match samples
common_samples <- intersect(rownames(rda_response), rownames(env_matrix_clean))
rda_response_clean <- rda_response[common_samples, ]
env_matrix_clean <- env_matrix_clean[common_samples, ]


# Hellinger transform on clean response matrix
rda_response_hel <- decostand(rda_response_clean, method = "hellinger")

# Run RDA
rda_result <- rda(rda_response_hel ~ ., data = env_matrix_clean)

# Summary
summary(rda_result)

# Test significance
anova(rda_result)
anova(rda_result, by = "axis")
```
